ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; predominantly low-intensity (black) central surface with high-intensity (white) distal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory from the median notch extending towards convex distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable dark linear mark on the right lobe tip and irregular jagged truncation of the far-right trailing edge.
